dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Phew... That's another batch of files organized. I'm making good progress!

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Honorary Senior Researcher, how wonderful to see you. I'm organizing these files and folders in accordance with Monsieur Raimondo's instructions.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: This part of the archive wasn't so badly hit by the explosion and is still structurally sound, so the files are in good shape.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Although I'm not sure how useful they are now... But we should at least get them properly filed first.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Yeah. I'll keep on organizing the documents.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you found anything of value?

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: A lot of it is old and out of date. Reports, memos, progress updates, things like that.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: But I found also some data from projects which were halted before completion, and even some detailed descriptions of their work.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: And those could be useful, as the Institute is planning to restart its research projects.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: So overall, everything is moving in the right direction. How wonderful.
